+def test_role_build_doc(collection, expected_name):
+    argspec = {'main': {'short_description': 'Main', 'options': {'value': {'type': 'str'}}},
+               'alternate': {'short_description': 'Alternate'}}
+
+    name, doc = RoleMixin()._build_doc('sample', '/roles/sample', collection, argspec)
+
+    assert name == expected_name
+    assert doc == {'path': '/roles/sample', 'collection': collection, 'entry_points': argspec}
+    assert doc['entry_points']['main'] is argspec['main']
+
+
+def test_role_build_doc_filters_entry_points():
+    argspec = {'main': {'options': {'value': {'type': 'str'}}}, 'alternate': {'options': {}}}
+
+    name, doc = RoleMixin()._build_doc('sample', '/roles/sample', None, argspec, 'main')
+
+    assert name == 'sample'
+    assert doc == {'path': '/roles/sample', 'collection': None, 'entry_points': {'main': argspec['main']}}
